description: SPIKE golden: recursive-compositional unfold of a DEPTH-2 box corner (base + edge flange F1 + return flange F2 folded off F1 with a PERPENDICULAR bend axis). Proves the deferred graph-relaxation case (docs/design/sheet-metal.md sec 4.3) is TRACTABLE with a clean tree walk: each flange is placed in its parent's ALREADY-flattened frame (child_2d = parent_2d(tangent) + BA*w_parent), so F2 composes THROUGH F1's development. Isolated spike (geometry.sheet_metal._spike_bend_chain), not the shipped unfold -- the shipped unfold_sheet_metal still rejects depth-2 with a typed UnfoldStarError, byte-unchanged.
tangent_line_convention: Each leg is measured to its bend TANGENT LINE (sec 9 #1). Base develops to its 40x30 flat top face; F1 develops to leg 25 (width 40 along the +X axis); F2 develops to leg 15 (width 25 along the +Z axis). Each bend allowance REPLACES a sharp-corner setback.
derivation: HAND-DERIVED analytic values (geometry-gates skill; independently recomputed in the test, never read from kernel output). Dims: base 40 (X) x 30 (Y) mm; F1 leg 25 (width 40, bend axis +X); F2 leg 15 (width 25, bend axis +Z, perpendicular to B1); gauge t=2, inner radius r=3, both bends 90deg, K=0.44 (v1 default).
Bend allowance (sec 1), same for both 90-deg bends at r=3,t=2,K=0.44: BA = (pi/2)*(3 + 0.44*2) = 6.094689747964199 mm.

Developed area (sec 9 #2 invariant): flat_area = base_area + F1_area + F2_area + strip1 + strip2 = (40*30) + (25*40) + (15*25) + (BA*40) + (BA*25) = 1200 + 1000 + 375 + BA*65 = 2575 + 396.15483361767295 = 2971.154833617673 mm^2. The base is counted ONCE.

Developed placements (the depth-2 crux, proven): F1 tangent line sits one BA beyond the base's y=+15 edge -> F1 occupies dev-Y [21.0947, 46.0947]. F2 folds off F1's x=+20 edge and, composed THROUGH F1's flat placement, sits one BA beyond it -> F2 occupies dev-X [26.0947, 41.0947] at F1's dev-Y band [21.0947, 46.0947]. Per-flange developed area equals its 3D face area to FP scale (isometry residual 0.0); each BA-strip width equals BA to ~3e-15 (no error accumulation through the parent's development). The three flanges occupy DISJOINT 2D regions (base y<15, F1 x<20, F2 x>26) -- no overlap, so the idealised zero-relief blank is valid (corner relief stays a sec 7 deferral).

Bounding-box envelope of the developed blank: flat_length (dev-X extent) = 40 base + (BA + 15) F2 arm = 61.094689747964196 mm; bend_width (dev-Y extent) = 30 base + (BA + 25) F1 arm = 61.0946897479642 mm.

Outline: three developed rectangles (base + F1 + F2), 4 body edges each = 12 body edges; one fold line per bend = 2 bend edges. (The spike emits per-flange rectangles + fold lines; assembling the single union boundary with the reentrant corner notch is FEATURE work, like the shipped nonparallel _emit_plus_pattern.) Both flanges fold to the +normal side -> direction 'up'.

Built body (sanity): fused volume = base(40*30*2=2400) + F1(flat 25*2*40=2000 + quarter-annulus (pi/4)(5^2-3^2)*40=160pi=502.65) + F2(flat 15*2*25=750 + (pi/4)(16)*25=100pi=314.16) = 2400 + 2502.65 + 1064.16 = 5966.814089933348 mm^3. EXACTLY additive (no 3D overlap) -- the geometric proof that the perpendicular return is a real, non-self-intersecting box corner.

content_hash is the sha256 of the unfold's FlatPattern.to_json_bytes() -- a DETERMINISM pin reproducible in-process AND across a fresh interpreter restart (sec 9 #4), pinned to OCCT/build123d. A change without a kernel-version bump is a determinism regression (P0), never a retry.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set. Measured residuals (2026-07-19, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9): per-flange developed area vs 3D face area 0.0, BA-strip offset residual ~2.7e-15 (no accumulation through the depth-2 composition), flat_area/envelope residuals ~1e-12 (arc-fit inner radii carry FP noise ~1e-14). Ceiling 1e-9 gives 2-3 orders of headroom while staying tighter than the kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m). Volume tolerance 1e-6 absorbs arc-fit noise scaled by width.
